relevance_note: Molecular study of two named LAD patients with beta subunit (CD18) mutations: 'Distinct mutations in two patients with leukocyte adhesion deficiency'.
method_note: Read in full by hand; no table transcription (the paper has no data tables). OCR text renders beta as 'fl', '0', '(3', '/3'; spans keep those characters. Patients 14 and 2 carry the identified variants; patients 1 and 15 are the other two of the 'four patients studied initially' (RNase protection assay, normal RNA and precursor protein; no mismatch found) and get rows without variants; their LAD diagnosis is implied by context (patient numbers refer to reference 24) rather than stated, so disease_label is 'not reported'. The gene symbol ITGB2 is never printed; gene_symbol_as_stated records 'CD18' (the paper's name for the common beta subunit). Patient 14: protein change printed as 'Leu149Pro'; nucleotide change printed only in prose ('T to C transition at nucleotide 517', 'substitution of a T for a C ... at nucleotide 517'), with no c. notation, so cdna_hgvs_as_stated is null. Patient 2: printed only in prose ('a substitution of a G for an A at nucleotide 577 which changes a glycine to an arginine at amino acid 169'; abstract 'an A for G substitution at amino acid 169'); no c./p. notation, so cdna/protein fields are null. Figure 3 label 'G1699' is an OCR artifact and was not used. Wording inconsistencies in the paper: 'substitution of a leucine for a proline' / 'substitution of the proline for the leucine' vs 'changes a leucine to a proline' and 'Leu149Pro'; 'substitution of a glycine for an arginine' (Results) vs 'mutated a glycine to an arginine' (Abstract) and 'changes a glycine to an arginine' (Fig. 2 legend); 'C for T difference' (Abstract) vs 'T to C transition' (Results); 'A for G' (Abstract) vs 'G for an A' (Results). Patient 14 second allele: the authors hypothesize a mutation 3' to nucleotide 965 ('between residues 277 and 747') but did not identify it; no variant row was created. Zygosity 'heterozygous' for Leu149Pro is from 'one of the ... alleles in patient 14 contains a mutation at nucleotide 517'. Patient 2 zygosity left 'not reported': the authors say homozygosity or a second non-expressed allele. Variant type 'missense' is from 'single amino acid substitutions in each of the two patients'. Functional evidence is from COS cell co-transfection. Earlier reports: patients numbered per reference 24 (printed list numbering; it is [16] in the structured reference list, PMID:3594570); parents' ethnicity/consanguinity cited to (2). Individuals are described first-hand here, so source_reference_in_review is 'not reported'. is_proband left null (no proband stated; not a single-patient case report). Study type 'case series/cohort' is a judgement: the paper is a laboratory molecular study of two patients.
